args.sql:
WITH ArtifactScores AS (
    SELECT 
        ac.artrefexamined AS ArtifactID,
        ac.condassessscore AS ConditionScore,
        ra.conservepriorityscore AS ConservationPriority,
        CASE 
            WHEN ascore.conservestatus ILIKE '%Poor%' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS PoorConservationStatus,
        ascore.artname AS ArtifactName,
        ascore.artdynasty AS HistoricalEra
    FROM 
        conditionassessments ac
    JOIN 
        riskassessments ra ON ac.artrefexamined = ra.artrefconcerned
    JOIN 
        artifactscore ascore ON ac.artrefexamined = ascore.artregistry
),
UrgencyScore AS (
    SELECT 
        ArtifactID,
        ArtifactName,
        HistoricalEra,
        (ConditionScore + ConservationPriority + PoorConservationStatus) AS TotalScore
    FROM 
        ArtifactScores
)
SELECT 
    ArtifactID,
    ArtifactName,
    HistoricalEra,
    TotalScore,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalScore DESC) AS UrgentCareRank
FROM 
    UrgencyScore
ORDER BY 
    UrgentCareRank;
